# Run a launcher
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Use Launchers to run a saved command for your user or the selected workspace.

## Open and run a launcher

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/launchers.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/macros.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/LaunchersPanel.vue -->

Open **Launchers** in the sidebar and select a launcher to run it. User launchers are available across workspaces; workspace launchers belong to the selected workspace.
